item.title: Ladybird vs Servo vs WebKitGTK in 2026: Which Open-Source Browser Engine Should You Embed?
item.description: If you are building a desktop application shell, a kiosk dashboard, or an appliance interface in 2026, you have one default choice: ship Chromium inside Electron and accept a 150 MB installation footprint, a monthly CVE treadmill, and an engine you cannot meaningfully customize. The alternatives have always existed, but they used to be academic curiosities. That is no longer true — one of them now counts 66,290 GitHub stars and pushed code today.
